# Security policy

Please report a vulnerability privately through this repository's **Security** tab, using **Report a
vulnerability**, rather than in a public issue. Include the steps to reproduce it and what an attacker could reach.

The hosted instance at https://mosaic-collab.vercel.app and the `main` branch are supported. How the app keeps
accounts, boards and AI agents apart is described in [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md) and
[docs/ai-assistant.md](../docs/ai-assistant.md).
